profiles.subset: Graphviz 16.1-compatible directed DOT: quoted or bare IDs, comments, labels/tooltips, directed node chains, and nested named cluster subgraphs (`subgraph cluster_*`) with scoped label/tooltip defaults; no anonymous or non-cluster subgraphs, ports, HTML labels, or undirected graphs. Import projects group role as region with a reported loss and reports unknown tier/layout semantics.

Mermaid 12.2.0 flowchart: bare/rectangular nodes, directed links and JSON-quoted YAML frontmatter titles; erDiagram: entities, fields, four cardinalities, relationship labels and JSON-quoted YAML frontmatter titles; sequenceDiagram: participants, native solid-call/dotted-return/open-async arrow forms, notes over two participants, and loop groups. Sequence form/layout and non-native visual fields are reported as losses. Sequence labels support ASCII spaces, tabs, and line feeds, which are numeric-escaped; other Unicode whitespace, controls except tab/line feed, and unpaired surrogates are refused. Titles preserve plain Unicode, quotes, backslashes, hashes, tabs, and line feeds; carriage returns, ampersands, and angle brackets altered by strict rendering are refused. Labels are plain text/numeric-escaped; raw HTML, Markdown, named entities, and literal angle brackets are outside this profile.

Lini 1.1.0 flat block/entity cards with quoted labels and optional tooltip hints mapped to Visual node detail, quoted field display types, and directed links between cards or declared fields; undirected links refuse; field tooltips and layout/style declarations are retained with loss reports.

policy: Native source emitted; counted diagnostics have loss:true. Refused targets are counted separately, not as emitted loss.
